name: Lyre Harmoniel
source:
While her personality can be smart, kind or brave by player's choices, her base personality is strong-hearted, impulsive and eager to learn.

Unfortunately, her strong sense of justice and habit of acting before she thinks has often led her to getting fired.

[From [url=https://chouette.itch.io/heroine-for-hire]itch.io[/url]]
